title: Poisonous Creeper Milk
description: This mod allows you to milk creepers, which give.. unusual effects
body:
Similar to the mod [Creeper Milk](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-milk-mod), this mod adds the ability to milk Creepers with a bucket, however ported to modern versions of the game.

This mod, instead of clearing effects and such, is actually quite nauseating and even makes your vision turn... green?
